title: AI Alignment for Digital Democracy: Fairer Voters Representation against LLM Biases
abstract: arXiv:2610.32780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI representation is emerging in digital democracy, assisting in voter emulation and decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) behave differently depending on the model, the prompt context, and the voter information they receive, representing some groups more accurately than others and potentially making the emulation unfair to certain groups. We investigate demographic biases in LLM-emulated electorates: how accurately LLMs represent individual votes, whether some voter groups are represented more accurately than others, and whether AI alignment can reduce these disparities without sacrificing overall accuracy. Using three U.S. presidential elections, we compare a closed-source and an open-source LLM across voters' demographic features and test AI alignment strategies toward fairer voter representation. Removing gender from the voter profile reduces the largest group error of the models by 22-42%, and removing education reduces it

translated_title: 面向数字民主的AI对齐：抵御大语言模型偏差的更公平选民代表性
translated_abstract: AI代表制正在数字民主领域兴起，用于协助模拟选民和辅助决策。大语言模型（LLM）的表现会因模型本身、提示语境以及其接收到的选民信息而有所不同，对某些群体的模拟比对其他群体更为准确，这可能使模拟结果对特定群体不公平。我们研究了LLM模拟选民群体中的人口统计学偏差：LLM对个人投票的模拟有多准确、某些选民群体是否比其他群体被更准确地代表，以及AI对齐能否在不牺牲整体准确性的前提下减少这些差异。基于三次美国总统选举的数据，我们比较了一个闭源模型和一个开源模型在不同选民人口特征上的表现，并测试了旨在实现更公平选民代表性的AI对齐策略。从选民画像中移除性别信息可使模型的最大群体误差降低22-42%，移除教育信息也能降低该误差。
tldr: 该研究揭示了LLM在模拟选民时存在人口统计学偏差，并提出通过AI对齐策略（如从选民画像中移除性别、教育等敏感特征）可将最大群体误差降低22-42%，从而在不牺牲整体准确性的前提下实现更公平的选民代表性。
en_tdlr: This study reveals demographic biases in LLM-emulated electorates and shows that AI alignment strategies, such as removing sensitive features like gender and education from voter profiles, can reduce the largest group error by 22-42%, achieving fairer voter representation without sacrificing overall accuracy.
